name: Tilonalli's Skinshifter — "it becomes a copy of another target nonlegendary attacking creature" offers only the other attacking creature
notes: "Whenever this creature attacks, it becomes a copy of another target nonlegendary attacking creature until end of turn." Found by the self-copy audit unit (2026-11-18). The copy picker offered every permanent on the board, the Skinshifter included: "attacking" was not read (the type-word restriction) and "it" was taken for a guessed target. Now only the attacking Grizzly Bears is offered (not Hill Giant, which is not attacking), and picking it makes the Skinshifter a Grizzly Bears.
